whatThisPluginAdds.text: Slideshow adds a Layout Builder widget for local responsive images with captions, optional calls to action, and visitor motion controls. It rejects remote media and unsafe URLs before rendering.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors assemble slides in Layout Builder, and visitors receive a public image sequence with captions and controls for advancing or pausing motion.

developers.text: The typed extension registers its public assets and validates slide media and links while tests protect the authoring boundary.

teams.text: Teams can publish an image sequence with useful captions and visitor-controlled motion without commissioning a custom carousel.

troubleshooting.cause: It has no slides or more than 20, or the label is over 100 characters
troubleshooting.check: Count the slides and check the label

troubleshooting.cause: The image is a web address, the alt text is empty, or the call-to-action link is not a site path or full web address
troubleshooting.check: Check the slide's image, alt text and link
troubleshooting.fix: Pick the image from the media library, describe it, and use a path such as `/offers` for links
